Cook chicken in a skillet 5 minutes per side.
Whisk Greek yogurt with lemon juice and a pinch of salt for tzatziki-style sauce.
Toast bread. Spread yogurt sauce. Layer chicken, cucumber, tomato, and feta.

name: Spicy Mexican Shrimp Wrap
instructions: Toss shrimp with chili powder, lime juice, and salt.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear shrimp 2 minutes per side.
Warm tortilla. Layer lettuce, avocado, shrimp, and salsa.
Roll tightly. Slice in half.

name: Asian Peanut Chicken Wrap
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet. Cook diced chicken 6-7 minutes until done.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, and lime juice with 1 tbsp warm water until smooth.
Toss cabbage and carrot with half the sauce.
Warm tortilla. Layer slaw and chicken, drizzle with remaining sauce. Roll tightly.

name: BBQ Chicken Ranch Wrap
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet. Cook diced chicken 6-7 minutes until done.
Toss chicken with BBQ sauce.
Warm tortilla. Spread ranch. Layer lettuce, chicken, corn, and cheddar. Roll tightly.

name: Falafel-Style Chickpea Wrap
instructions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, cumin, and a pinch of salt in a food processor (or mash by hand) until coarse paste forms.
Form into 6 small patties.
Heat olive oil in a skillet. Pan-fry patties 3 minutes per side until golden.
Whisk Greek yogurt with lemon juice for sauce.
Warm tortilla. Spread sauce, layer patties, cucumber, and tomato. Roll tightly.

name: Italian Antipasto Wrap
instructions: Whisk olive oil, vinegar, and Italian seasoning.
Lay tortilla flat. Drizzle dressing across the center.
Layer lettuce, turkey, mozzarella, and tomato.
Roll tightly. Slice on the diagonal.

name: Toasted Cheddar & Apple Sandwich
instructions: Butter outside of both bread slices.
Spread mustard on the inside of one slice.
Layer cheddar, apple slices, and more cheddar.
Toast in a skillet over medium 3-4 minutes per side until golden and melted.

name: Asian Ginger Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Combine broth, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and sesame oil in a pot. Bring to a simmer for 8 minutes.
Add sliced chicken, simmer 6 minutes until cooked through.
Add noodles (no seasoning packet) and spinach, cook 3 more minutes.
Ladle into bowls, top with green onion.

name: Italian Wedding Soup with Turkey Meatballs

ingredients.measure: 1/4 cup grated, plus more to serve

instructions: Mix turkey with parmesan, half the Italian seasoning, garlic, and a pinch of salt.
Roll into small marble-sized meatballs (about 24).
Heat olive oil in a soup pot. Sauté onion and carrots 5 minutes.
Pour in broth and remaining Italian seasoning. Bring to a simmer.
Drop in meatballs, simmer 8 minutes.
Add pasta, cook 8 more minutes.
Stir in squeezed spinach. Serve with extra parmesan.

name: Hearty Vegetable & Lentil Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot. Sauté onion, carrot, and celery 5 minutes.
Add garlic and Italian seasoning, cook 30 seconds.
Pour in tomatoes, broth, and rinsed lentils. Bring to a boil, reduce to simmer.
Simmer 25 minutes until lentils are tender.
Stir in frozen mixed veg, simmer 5 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Loaded Baked Potato Soup
instructions: Cook bacon in a soup pot until crisp. Remove, crumble, set aside. Keep 1 tbsp fat.
Sauté onion in bacon fat 4 minutes. Add garlic, 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in flour, stir 1 minute. Add broth and potatoes.
Simmer 18 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Mash some potatoes against the pot side to thicken.
Stir in milk, half the cheese, and most of the bacon. Season with salt and pepper.
Top each bowl with sour cream, remaining cheese, bacon, and green onion.

name: Shrimp & Corn Chowder
instructions: Cook bacon in a pot until crisp. Crumble and set aside. Keep 1 tbsp fat.
Sauté onion in bacon fat 4 minutes. Add garlic and paprika, 30 seconds.
Sprinkle in flour. Pour in broth and add potatoes.
Simmer 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Stir in corn and milk, simmer 5 minutes.
Add shrimp, cook 3-4 minutes until pink.
Top with crumbled bacon. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Beef & Mushroom Brown Rice Soup
instructions: Brown beef in a soup pot, breaking it up. Drain excess fat.
Add olive oil, onion, carrot, and celery. Cook 5 minutes.
Add mushrooms, cook 5 minutes until they release liquid.
Add garlic and Italian seasoning, cook 30 seconds.
Pour in broth and brown rice. Bring to a boil, reduce to simmer.
Cover and simmer 30 minutes until rice is tender. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Italian Meatball Sub
instructions: Mix beef with parmesan, half the Italian seasoning, onion, garlic, and salt.
Roll into 8 meatballs.
Heat olive oil in a skillet. Brown meatballs on all sides, 6 minutes total.
Pour in marinara, simmer 10 minutes until meatballs are cooked through.
Split rolls, hollow out a little bread. Pile meatballs and sauce inside.
Top with mozzarella. Broil 2-3 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.

name: Tuscan White Bean & Spinach Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a soup pot. Sauté onion 5 minutes.
Add garlic and Italian seasoning, cook 30 seconds.
Pour in tomatoes, broth, and one can of beans.
Mash the second can of beans with a fork; add to the pot to thicken.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach and warm through, 2 minutes.
Top each bowl with parmesan and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Thai Peanut Shrimp Noodles
instructions: Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, ginger, honey, and 3 tbsp warm water until smooth.
Cook noodles per package, discarding seasoning. Drain and rinse.
Heat sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear shrimp 2 minutes per side until pink.
Toss noodles and shrimp with sauce. Top with cilantro and a lime wedge.

name: Thai-Style Chicken Lettuce Cups
instructions: Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, half the lime juice, and 2 tbsp warm water until smooth.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add garlic, ginger, and half the jalapeño, cook 30 seconds.
Add chicken, cook 6-7 minutes until cooked through, breaking it up.
Stir in peanut sauce, simmer 1 minute.
Spoon into lettuce cups. Top with cilantro, remaining jalapeño, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Thai Peanut Tofu Bowl
instructions: Cook brown rice per package directions (about 40 minutes).
Press tofu between paper towels for 5 minutes, then cube.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, ginger, and 3 tbsp warm water until smooth.
Heat half the sesame oil in a skillet. Crisp tofu cubes on all sides, 8 minutes total.
In a second pan (or after removing tofu), heat remaining sesame oil and stir-fry frozen veg 5 minutes.
Assemble bowls: rice, veg, tofu. Drizzle with sauce and top with cilantro.

name: Thai Mango Peanut Yogurt Bowl
instructions: Whisk yogurt with lime juice and honey.
Top with thawed mango, a swirl of peanut butter, and a sprinkle of raw oats.

name: Thai Peanut Banana Oats
instructions: Cook oats with milk until creamy, about 4 minutes.
Stir in peanut butter until melted in.
Top with banana slices, drizzle of honey, and a pinch of lime zest.

name: Thai-Inspired Egg Crepe with Cilantro
instructions: Whisk eggs with soy sauce until uniform.
Heat sesame oil in a non-stick skillet over medium.
Pour in eggs and swirl to coat. Cook 2-3 minutes until set.
Sprinkle cilantro, green onion, and jalapeño across one half.
Fold crepe in half. Serve with a lime wedge.

name: Indian Chana-Style Chickpea Scramble
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium. Sauté onion 4 minutes until soft.
Add garlic, ginger, cumin, and chili powder. Cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in diced tomato, cook 3 minutes until it breaks down.
Add chickpeas with 2 tbsp water. Mash about a third with a fork.
Simmer 4 minutes. Stir in lemon juice and salt. Top with cilantro.

name: Indian Masala Omelet
instructions: Whisk eggs with cumin, chili powder, and salt.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium.
Sauté onion, tomato, and jalapeño 2 minutes.
Pour in eggs and stir gently to mix with veg. Sprinkle cilantro.
Cook undisturbed 2 minutes, then fold in half. Plate immediately.

name: Indian-Spiced Sweet Potato Hash with Eggs
instructions: Dice sweet potato into 1/2-inch cubes.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium. Cover and cook potato 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Uncover, add onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, and chili powder. Cook 4 minutes uncovered to crisp.
Make two wells and crack in eggs. Cover and cook 3-4 minutes until whites set.
Top with cilantro. Serve with lemon wedge.

name: Garden Chicken Salad with Lemon Dressing
instructions: Pound chicken to even thickness. Rub with 1 tbsp olive oil, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high. Cook chicken 5-6 minutes per side. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Whisk remaining olive oil, lemon juice, mustard, salt, and pepper for dressing.
Toss greens, cucumber, tomato, and bell pepper with half the dressing.
Plate salad, top with sliced chicken, drizzle remaining dressing.

name: Seared Salmon Over Fresh Garden Greens
instructions: Pat salmon dry, season with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high.
Sear salmon skin-side down 4 minutes, flip and cook 3 more.
Whisk remaining oil with lemon, mustard, and honey for dressing.
Toss greens and cucumber with half the dressing. Top with avocado.
Place salmon over greens, drizzle with remaining dressing.

name: Roasted Garden Veggie & Chickpea Sheet Pan
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Toss chickpeas and vegetables on a sheet pan with olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast 25-30 minutes, stirring once, until tender and browned at edges.
Whisk Greek yogurt with lemon juice, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt for sauce.
Pile veg into bowls. Drizzle with yogurt sauce.

name: Garden Cobb Dinner Bowl
instructions: Hard-boil eggs (10 minutes in boiling water), cool in ice bath, peel, and quarter.
Cook bacon in a skillet until crisp. Drain and crumble.
Season diced chicken with salt and pepper, cook in bacon fat 6-7 minutes.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, mustard, salt, and pepper for dressing.
Arrange chopped lettuce on a platter. Top with rows of chicken, bacon, egg, avocado, tomato, and feta.
Drizzle with dressing just before serving.

name: Chicken Sausage & Veggie Breakfast Skillet
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Cook potato covered 8 minutes.
Add onion and bell pepper, cook uncovered 4 minutes.
Push to side, add sausage and brown 4 minutes.
Stir in garlic and paprika.
Make three wells, crack in eggs. Cover and cook 3 minutes until whites set.

name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Wrap
instructions: Cook bacon in a skillet until crisp. Drain and crumble.
Heat olive oil in the same skillet. Cook diced chicken 6-7 minutes until done.
Warm tortilla. Spread ranch. Layer lettuce, chicken, bacon, tomato, and cheddar.
Fold sides and roll tightly.

name: Chicken Pot Pie Soup
instructions: Melt butter in a pot over medium. Sauté onion 4 minutes.
Sprinkle in flour, stir 1 minute to form roux.
Whisk in broth gradually. Add garlic, diced potato, and chicken.
Simmer 15 minutes until potatoes are tender and chicken cooked through.
Stir in frozen veg and milk. Simmer 5 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.

name: Pesto-Style Chicken Panini
instructions: Stir 1 tbsp olive oil with garlic, Italian seasoning, parmesan, and a pinch of salt for quick pesto-style spread.
Heat remaining olive oil in a skillet. Cook sliced chicken 4 minutes per side.
Brush outside of bread slices with a little oil. Spread pesto-style mix inside.
Layer chicken, mozzarella, and tomato between bread.
Press in skillet over medium 3 minutes per side until golden and melted.

name: Korean-Style Chicken Bowl
instructions: Cook brown rice per package directions.
Whisk soy sauce, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, honey, and hot sauce.
Heat a skillet over medium-high. Cook diced chicken 6-7 minutes until done.
Pour in sauce, simmer 2 minutes to glaze.
Steam broccoli until tender, 4 minutes.
Layer rice, chicken, and broccoli in bowls. Top with green onion.

name: Chicken Tikka-Style Skillet
instructions: Marinate chicken cubes in yogurt, half the cumin, paprika, ginger, and salt for 10 minutes.
Cook rice per package directions.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear chicken pieces 5 minutes until browned. Remove.
Sauté onion 5 minutes. Add garlic, remaining cumin, chili powder, cook 30 seconds.
Pour in tomatoes, simmer 8 minutes until thickened.
Return chicken, simmer 5 more minutes.
Serve over rice, topped with cilantro.

name: Tuscan Chicken with Spinach
instructions: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and half the Italian seasoning.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear chicken 6 minutes per side. Remove.
Sauté onion 4 minutes. Add garlic, cook 30 seconds.
Sprinkle flour, stir 1 minute. Pour in milk and tomatoes. Add remaining Italian seasoning.
Stir in spinach and parmesan. Simmer 5 minutes.
Return chicken to sauce, simmer 3 more minutes.

name: Honey Garlic Chicken Stir Fry
instructions: Cook rice per package directions.
Whisk soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Stir-fry chicken 5 minutes until cooked through.
Add frozen veg, stir-fry 4 minutes.
Pour in sauce, toss until everything is glazed, 1 minute.
Serve over rice.

name: Cajun Chicken & Rice Skillet
instructions: Toss chicken with paprika, chili powder, and salt.
Heat olive oil in a deep skillet over medium-high. Brown chicken 5 minutes. Remove.
Sauté onion, bell pepper, and celery 5 minutes (the Cajun trinity).
Add garlic, cook 30 seconds.
Stir in rice to toast 1 minute. Pour in broth.
Return chicken. Cover and simmer 18 minutes until rice absorbs liquid.
Fluff with a fork. Drizzle hot sauce if desired.

name: Buffalo Chicken Mac & Cheese

ingredients.measure: 1 tbsp dry ranch or 2 tbsp dressing for drizzle

instructions: Cook pasta to al dente; drain.
Season chicken with salt and pepper. Cook in a hot skillet 6-7 minutes. Toss with hot sauce.
Melt butter in a pot. Whisk in flour, cook 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in milk. Simmer 3 minutes until thickened.
Off heat, stir in cheddar until smooth.
Combine pasta, cheese sauce, and buffalo chicken.
Top with green onion and a ranch drizzle.

name: Beef & Egg Breakfast Hash
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Cook diced potato covered 10 minutes.
Add onion and bell pepper, cook uncovered 4 minutes.
Push to side, brown beef with paprika, breaking it up, 5 minutes. Drain fat.
Mix everything together. Make three wells, crack in eggs.
Cover and cook 3-4 minutes until whites set.

name: Sloppy Joe Sandwich
instructions: Brown beef in a skillet, breaking it up. Drain fat.
Add onion and bell pepper, cook 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic, tomato sauce, ketchup, mustard, honey, and vinegar.
Simmer 8-10 minutes until thickened.
Spoon onto toasted buns. Eat immediately — it's messy on purpose.

name: Cheesy Beef Quesadilla
instructions: Brown beef with diced onion in a skillet. Drain fat.
Stir in taco seasoning and 2 tbsp water. Simmer 2 minutes.
Heat a clean skillet over medium. Place one tortilla in, sprinkle half the cheese.
Top with beef mixture, salsa, and remaining cheese. Cover with second tortilla.
Cook 3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until golden and melted.
Slice into wedges.

name: Beef Lettuce Wrap Tacos with Lime Crema
instructions: Brown beef in a skillet, breaking it up. Drain fat.
Stir in taco seasoning and 3 tbsp water. Simmer 2 minutes.
Whisk sour cream with lime juice and a pinch of salt for crema.
Spoon beef into lettuce cups. Top with salsa, jalapeño, cilantro, and a drizzle of crema.

name: Beef Pho-Inspired Noodle Soup
instructions: Brown beef in a soup pot, breaking it small. Drain fat.
Add broth, ginger, garlic, half the onion, and soy sauce. Simmer 12 minutes.
Strain out the aromatics (or fish out the chunks of onion and ginger).
Return broth and beef to pot. Add noodles, cook 3 minutes.
Ladle into bowls. Top with green onion, cilantro, jalapeño, and lime. Add hot sauce to taste.

name: Italian Beef Ragu with Pasta
instructions: Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven. Sauté onion, carrot, and celery 8 minutes.
Add garlic, cook 30 seconds.
Push to side, brown beef 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir in tomatoes and Italian seasoning. Simmer covered 25 minutes, stirring once or twice.
Meanwhile, cook pasta to al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with ragu and a splash of pasta water. Finish with parmesan.

name: Beef Picadillo with Rice
instructions: Cook rice per package directions.
Heat olive oil in a skillet. Sauté onion and bell pepper 5 minutes.
Add garlic, jalapeño, cumin, and chili powder. Cook 30 seconds.
Brown beef 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Stir in tomatoes. Simmer 12 minutes until thickened.
Serve over rice. Top with cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

name: Korean Ground Beef Bowl
instructions: Cook rice per package directions.
Brown beef in a skillet, breaking it up. Drain fat.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 30 seconds.
Whisk soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, and hot sauce. Pour over beef. Simmer 3 minutes.
Steam broccoli until tender, 4 minutes.
Layer rice, beef, and broccoli in bowls. Top with green onion.

name: Beef Goulash Skillet
instructions: Brown beef in a deep skillet, breaking it up. Drain fat.
Add onion and bell pepper, cook 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Cook 30 seconds.
Pour in tomatoes, sauce, and broth. Bring to a boil.
Add uncooked pasta. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer 14 minutes, stirring once.
Top with cheddar, cover 2 more minutes to melt.

name: French Onion Beef Sliders
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium-low. Add onions and a pinch of salt.
Cook 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deeply caramelized. Add garlic and balsamic in the last minute.
Heat olive oil in a separate skillet. Form beef into 6 small patties, season with salt and Italian seasoning.
Cook patties 3 minutes per side. Top each with onions and mozzarella in the last minute. Cover to melt.
Stir broth into the empty pan, scraping up bits, to make au jus.
Build sliders on toasted buns. Serve with au jus on the side.

name: Apple Cinnamon Oat Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F. Line a 12-cup muffin tin or grease wells.
Whisk flour, oats, sugar, salt, and a pinch of cinnamon (if you have it) in a large bowl.
In a second bowl whisk eggs, milk, and melted butter until smooth.
Fold wet into dry just until combined — a few floury streaks are fine. Stir in diced apple.
Divide batter between muffin cups. Bake 18-22 minutes until tops spring back.

name: Savory Cheddar Cornbread Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F. Line a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk cornbread mix, eggs, and milk per box directions. Fold in cheddar, green onion, and jalapeño.
Divide between muffin cups, filling about 3/4 full.
Bake 15-18 minutes until tops are golden and a pick comes out clean.
Cool 5 minutes before unmolding.

name: Banana Bread Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F. Line a 12-cup muffin tin.
Mash bananas in a large bowl. Whisk in eggs, peanut butter, sugar, milk, and melted butter.
Stir in flour and salt just until combined — overmixing makes them tough.
Divide batter between muffin cups.
Bake 22-26 minutes until tops are domed and a pick comes out with a few moist crumbs.

name: Buttermilk Blueberry Waffles
instructions: Heat waffle iron. Whisk flour, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
In a second bowl whisk egg yolks, milk, and melted butter. Pour into dry and stir just until combined.
Beat egg whites to soft peaks and fold gently into the batter — keeps the waffles light.
Ladle batter into the iron, scatter frozen berries on top, and cook until deeply golden.
Serve hot with butter and a drizzle of honey if you have it.

name: Cinnamon Banana Waffles
instructions: Heat waffle iron. Mash bananas in a large bowl.
Whisk eggs, milk, melted butter, and sugar into the bananas.
Stir in flour and salt just until combined — a few small lumps are fine.
Ladle into the waffle iron and cook until crisp and golden.
Serve hot with extra banana slices and a drizzle of honey or peanut butter.

name: Breakfast Tacos with Egg & Salsa
instructions: Warm tortillas in a dry skillet, 20 seconds per side, then stack under a towel.
Beat eggs with a pinch of salt. Melt butter in a skillet over medium-low.
Add eggs and stir gently until just set — pull off the heat while still glossy.
Build tacos: a scoop of egg, shredded cheddar, salsa, avocado, and a pinch of cilantro.
Serve right away while the tortillas are warm.

name: Tomato & Mozzarella Breakfast Salad with Soft Egg
instructions: Bring a small pot of water to a simmer. Lower eggs in gently and soft-boil for 6 1/2 minutes.
Cool eggs briefly under cold water, then peel and halve.
Arrange lettuce, tomato, and mozzarella on plates. Top with halved eggs.
Whisk olive oil, balsamic, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper into a quick vinaigrette.
Drizzle dressing over the salad and serve right away.

name: Sweet Potato & Sausage Breakfast Sandwich
instructions: Toss sweet potato slices with olive oil, paprika, and salt. Roast at 425°F for 12-15 minutes until tender and edges crisp.
Meanwhile cook sausage patties in a skillet over medium until browned on both sides and cooked through.
Crack eggs into the same skillet, season with salt, and cook to your liking (over-medium pairs nicely).
Toast bread. Stack each sandwich: bread → cheese → sausage → sweet potato → egg → bread.
Press lightly so the cheese starts to melt, then slice and serve.

name: Classic Cheeseburger with Cucumber-Tomato Side Salad

ingredients.measure: 4 leaves (2 for burger, 2 chopped for salad)
thin slices for burger + a few rings for salad

instructions: Toss cucumber, tomato wedges, a few onion rings, and chopped lettuce in a bowl. Whisk olive oil, vinegar, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; dress the salad and let it sit while you cook the burger.
Form ground beef into a loose 1/3 lb patty, slightly wider than the bun. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat a heavy skillet over high until smoking. Add the patty and press once; cook 2 minutes per side for medium.
Lay the cheese on the patty in the last 30 seconds; cover briefly to melt.
Butter the cut sides of the buns and toast face-down in a separate pan until golden.
Build: bottom bun, mayo, lettuce, tomato, patty with cheese, onion, ketchup, top bun. Plate with the cucumber-tomato salad on the side.

name: Bacon Cheeseburger with Crispy Onion Rings
instructions: Slice onion into thick rings, separate the layers. Soak in milk 5 minutes.
Heat 1 inch of oil in a heavy pot to 360°F. Mix flour, paprika, and salt on a plate.
Dredge each ring in the flour, fry 2-3 minutes until deep golden, drain on paper towels and salt immediately.
Cook bacon in a skillet until crisp; drain. In the bacon fat, form a 1/3 lb patty and cook 2 min per side, melting cheese in the last 30 seconds.
Toast the bun face-down in the same pan. Build: bun, lettuce, patty with cheese, bacon, top bun. Pile onion rings on the side.

name: Crispy Chicken Tenders with Mashed Potatoes & Green Beans
instructions: Boil cubed potato in salted water 15 minutes until fork-tender; drain.
Mash with warm milk and 2 tbsp butter until smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Cover to keep warm.
Set up dredging: flour seasoned with paprika and salt; beaten egg; breadcrumbs.
Dredge each tender in flour, then egg, then crumbs. Press to adhere.
Shallow-fry tenders in 1/4 inch oil over medium-high, 3 minutes per side, until golden and 165°F inside. Drain on paper towels.
Meanwhile, sauté green beans with garlic and the remaining tbsp butter for 4 minutes until just tender.
Plate mashed potatoes, tenders, and green beans together.

name: Honey-Mustard Chicken Tenders with Sweet Potato Fries
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss sweet-potato fries with 1 tbsp olive oil, paprika, and salt. Spread on a sheet pan in a single layer.
Roast 20 minutes, flipping once halfway through.
Dredge tenders: flour with salt, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Heat remaining oil in a skillet over medium-high. Pan-fry tenders 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Whisk honey, mustard, and mayo for a quick dipping sauce.
Serve tenders alongside the fries with the honey-mustard.

name: Country Meatloaf with Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. Soak breadcrumbs in milk for 5 minutes.
Mix beef, egg, soaked crumbs, onion-garlic, 3 tbsp ketchup, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper just until combined — don't overwork.
Shape into a 9x5 loaf on a parchment-lined sheet pan. Brush the top with the remaining ketchup.
Bake 45-55 minutes until internal temperature hits 160°F. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.
While it bakes, boil potatoes 15 minutes until tender; mash with butter, a splash of milk, salt, and pepper.
Slice meatloaf and serve over the mash.

name: Buffalo Chicken Tenders with Ranch Slaw
instructions: Toss cabbage and carrots with mayo, ranch mix, and a pinch of salt. Refrigerate while you cook.
Whisk hot sauce and melted butter for the buffalo coating; set aside.
Dredge tenders in seasoned flour, then egg, then flour again for an extra-crispy coat.
Shallow-fry in 1/4 inch oil over medium-high, 3 minutes per side until golden and 165°F inside.
Toss hot tenders in the buffalo sauce.
Serve over the ranch slaw.

name: Smash Burger with Onion Rings

ingredients.measure: 1 large onion for rings + thin slices for burger

instructions: Cut onion into rings; soak in milk while you heat 1 inch of oil to 360°F.
Dredge rings in seasoned flour and fry 2-3 minutes until deep golden; drain and salt immediately.
Get a cast-iron skillet ripping hot. Place beef balls on the dry pan and smash flat with a spatula — paper-thin is the goal.
Season the tops, cook 90 seconds until the edges are lacy and crispy. Flip, top each with cheese, cook 30 seconds more.
Butter the cut sides of the bun and toast in the same skillet.
Build: bun, mayo, two stacked patties, raw onion, top bun. Serve with the onion rings.

name: Turkey Burger with Sweet Potato Fries

ingredients.measure: thin slices + 1 clove garlic for the patty

instructions: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss sweet-potato fries with 1 tbsp olive oil, paprika, and salt. Roast 20 minutes, flipping halfway.
Mix ground turkey with minced garlic, Italian seasoning, and a pinch of salt. Form a 1/3 lb patty.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Cook the patty 4 minutes per side until 165°F inside, melting cheese in the last 30 seconds.
Toast the bun face-down in the skillet.
Build: bun, mayo, lettuce, patty with cheese, tomato, onion, top bun. Serve with the fries.

name: Slow Cooker Classic Beef Stew

ingredients.measure: 1 lb stew beef or chuck, cubed

instructions: Dredge cubed beef in seasoned flour. Sear in olive oil over high heat in batches until browned on all sides; transfer to slow cooker.
Add onion, garlic, carrots, celery, and potato to the slow cooker.
Pour broth and tomato sauce over; stir in Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Cook on LOW 7-8 hours or HIGH 4 hours until beef is fork-tender.
Taste and adjust salt. Serve in deep bowls with crusty bread if you have it.

name: Slow Cooker Pot Roast with Vegetables
instructions: Pat roast dry, season generously with salt and pepper. Sear in olive oil on all sides until deeply browned (~3 min/side).
Place roast in slow cooker. Scatter onion, garlic, carrots, and potato around it.
Pour broth around the roast; sprinkle ranch mix and Italian seasoning over top.
Cook on LOW 8 hours until the roast pulls apart with a fork.
Lift roast out, slice or shred, and serve with the vegetables and pan juices.

name: Slow Cooker BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Slaw

ingredients.measure: 2 lb pork shoulder (or thick-cut pork chops)

instructions: Rub pork with paprika, chili powder, and salt. Layer onion and garlic in the slow cooker; place pork on top.
Pour half the BBQ sauce over the pork. Cook on LOW 8 hours or HIGH 5 hours until shreddable.
Shred with two forks in the cooker, stir in the remaining BBQ sauce, and let it sit on LOW another 15 minutes to soak up flavor.
Whisk mayo, vinegar, sugar, and salt for slaw dressing. Toss with cabbage and shredded carrot.
Pile pork on toasted buns; top with slaw.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Tortilla Soup
instructions: Combine chicken, beans, corn, tomatoes, salsa, broth, onion, garlic, cumin, chili powder, and salt in the slow cooker.
Cook on LOW 6 hours or HIGH 3-4 hours until chicken is cooked through.
Lift chicken out, shred with two forks, and return to the pot.
Meanwhile, toast tortilla strips in a dry skillet or 400°F oven until crispy, ~6 minutes.
Ladle soup into bowls; top with tortilla strips, cheddar, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Slow Cooker Indian-Style Chicken Curry over Rice
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger in olive oil until soft (~5 min). Stir in cumin, paprika, and chili powder; cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Transfer to slow cooker with chicken thighs, crushed tomatoes, broth, and salt.
Cook on LOW 6 hours or HIGH 3 hours until chicken pulls apart easily.
Shred chicken in the pot with two forks. Turn off heat and stir in the yogurt (off-heat keeps it from breaking).
Serve over rice; garnish with cilantro.

name: Slow Cooker Korean-Style Beef Rice Bowl

ingredients.measure: 1 lb flank steak or chuck, sliced thin

instructions: Combine beef, onion, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, and broth in the slow cooker.
Cook on LOW 6 hours or HIGH 3 hours until beef is tender.
Skim excess fat from the top if needed. Stir to coat in the sauce.
Serve over brown rice with raw cabbage, julienned carrot, and green onions on top.
Drizzle with hot sauce to taste.

name: Sheet Pan Shrimp Boil
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F. Boil potatoes 8 minutes until just tender; drain.
Spread potatoes, sausage, and corn on a sheet pan. Toss with half the melted butter, half the garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast 15 minutes until potatoes are crisp at the edges.
Toss shrimp with the remaining butter and garlic. Add to the pan, give everything a stir, and roast another 5-7 minutes until shrimp is pink and curled.
Serve straight from the pan with lemon wedges to squeeze over.

name: Sheet Pan Italian Meatballs with Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F. Mix beef, egg, breadcrumbs, half the parmesan, onion-garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper until just combined.
Roll into 16 meatballs (about 1.5 inch each). Place on a parchment-lined sheet pan.
Toss zucchini and bell pepper with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread around the meatballs.
Roast 20-25 minutes until meatballs reach 160°F and vegetables are golden at the edges.
Plate meatballs and vegetables; spoon warm marinara over and shower with the remaining parmesan.

name: Sheet Pan Greek Chicken with Lemon & Feta

ingredients.measure: 4 cloves garlic + 1 small onion in wedges

instructions: Heat oven to 425°F. Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Toss chicken thighs, potatoes, peppers, zucchini, onion, and tomato wedges with the dressing on a large sheet pan.
Roast 30-35 minutes, stirring vegetables once halfway, until chicken reaches 175°F and the edges are caramelized.
Scatter crumbled feta over the hot pan; let it soften 1 minute.
Serve straight from the pan with extra lemon wedges to squeeze over.

name: One-Pot Creamy Tomato Chicken Pasta

ingredients.measure: 1/4 cup grated, plus extra to serve
1 cup (optional, stirred in at the end)

instructions: Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high. Season chicken with salt, pepper, and half the Italian seasoning; sear 4 minutes until browned. Lift out.
Add onion and garlic to the pot; cook 3 minutes until soft.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, broth, the rest of the Italian seasoning, and dry pasta. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook 10-12 minutes, stirring once, until pasta is al dente and liquid is mostly absorbed.
Return chicken to the pot. Stir in cream cheese and parmesan until creamy. Fold in spinach if using; cook 2 more minutes.
Serve in bowls with extra parmesan on top.

name: Slow Cooker French Dip Sandwiches
instructions: Season roast with salt and pepper. Sear in olive oil on all sides until deeply browned.
Transfer to slow cooker with onion, garlic, broth, soy sauce, and Italian seasoning.
Cook on LOW 8 hours until beef shreds easily.
Shred beef in the pot; strain broth into bowls for dipping (the au jus).
Pile beef on toasted rolls, top with cheese, broil 2 minutes until melty. Serve with au jus on the side.

name: Slow Cooker Cuban-Style Mojo Pork over Rice

ingredients.measure: 2 lb pork shoulder (or thick pork chops)

instructions: Whisk lime juice, orange juice, garlic, cumin, olive oil, salt, and pepper for the mojo marinade.
Place pork and sliced onion in slow cooker; pour mojo over.
Cook on LOW 8 hours until shreddable.
Shred pork in the pot, toss in the cooking juices.
Serve over rice with warmed black beans, cilantro, and lime wedges.

name: Slow Cooker Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs
instructions: Whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil. Pour over chicken thighs in the slow cooker.
Cook on LOW 5 hours or HIGH 3 hours until chicken is tender.
Lift chicken out; reduce the sauce in a small pot over high heat 5 minutes until syrupy.
Steam broccoli while sauce reduces.
Plate chicken over rice with broccoli; spoon sauce over and scatter green onions on top.

name: Sheet Pan Pork Chops with Apple & Sweet Potato
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss sweet potato and onion with 2 tbsp olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread on a sheet pan.
Roast 15 minutes while you season the pork chops with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning.
Whisk honey and mustard. Push veggies to one side; add chops and apple slices to the pan. Brush chops with the honey-mustard glaze.
Roast another 18-22 minutes until pork reaches 145°F and apples are caramelized.
Rest pork 5 minutes before serving with the apples and sweet potatoes.

name: Sheet Pan Maple-Mustard Salmon with Broccoli
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast on a sheet pan 15 minutes.
Whisk honey, mustard, garlic, 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper into a glaze.
Toss broccoli with the remaining olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Push potatoes aside; add salmon (skin-side down) and broccoli. Brush salmon thickly with the maple-mustard glaze.
Roast another 10-12 minutes until salmon flakes and broccoli is just-tender. Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Sheet Pan Tex-Mex Chicken with Black Beans & Corn
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss chicken, peppers, and onion with olive oil and taco seasoning.
Spread on a sheet pan; roast 18 minutes, stirring once halfway.
Scatter black beans and corn over the pan; sprinkle cheese on top.
Roast another 5 minutes until cheese melts and edges crisp.
Serve straight from the pan with warm tortillas, cilantro, salsa, and lime.

name: One-Pot Beef & Broccoli over Rice
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a deep skillet over high. Sear beef in a single layer 2 minutes until browned; flip and add garlic and ginger. Cook 1 minute.
Pour in soy sauce, honey, and broth. Bring to a simmer.
Add broccoli; cover and cook 5 minutes until tender and the sauce thickens.
Taste and adjust salt if needed.
Spoon over rice; garnish with green onions.

name: One-Pot Cheesy Chicken & Broccoli Rice
instructions: Melt butter in a Dutch oven over medium-high. Season chicken with salt, pepper, and paprika; cook 5 minutes until browned. Lift out.
Add onion and garlic to the pot; cook 2 minutes.
Stir in rice; toast 1 minute. Pour in broth and bring to a boil.
Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 15 minutes. Add broccoli on top (don't stir) and cook another 5 minutes until rice is tender.
Return chicken to the pot; stir in cheese until melted. Serve in bowls.

name: One-Pot Cheesy Beef Taco Skillet
instructions: Heat olive oil in a deep skillet. Sauté onion and garlic 2 minutes; add beef and brown, breaking it up.
Drain excess fat. Stir in taco seasoning to coat.
Add rice, broth, beans, corn, and salsa. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook 18 minutes until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Sprinkle cheese over the top; cover off-heat 2 minutes to melt. Garnish with cilantro and serve from the pan.

name: Skillet Lasagna
instructions: Brown beef with onion and garlic in olive oil in a deep skillet, breaking it up. Drain fat.
Stir in Italian seasoning, marinara, and broth. Bring to a simmer.
Submerge broken pasta in the sauce. Cover and cook 12-15 minutes, stirring once, until pasta is al dente.
Dollop cottage cheese over the top in spoonfuls; scatter mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover off-heat 5 minutes until cheese melts and the cottage cheese softens into ricotta-like pockets. Serve straight from the pan.

name: Cinnamon Banana Overnight Oats Jar
instructions: Layer oats, milk, peanut butter, honey, and a pinch of cinnamon (if you have it) in a mason jar.
Add half the banana slices and stir to combine.
Seal and refrigerate overnight (or at least 4 hours).
In the morning, top with the remaining banana slices and eat straight from the jar.

name: Berry Granola Skillet
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium. Stir in oats and honey; toast 5 minutes until golden and fragrant.
Push oats to one side; add frozen berries to the empty side and warm for 2 minutes until juicy.
Spoon yogurt into bowls; top with the toasted oats, warm berries, and banana slices.
Drizzle with a touch more honey if you like.

name: Sweet Potato Hash with Poached Eggs
instructions: Cook bacon in a wide skillet until crisp; lift out and reserve, leave the fat in the pan.
Add olive oil if needed. Toss in sweet potato, onion, pepper, garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until crispy at the edges.

While hash finishes, bring a small pot of water to a bare simmer; add vinegar. Crack each egg into a small cup, then slip into the swirling water. Poach 3 minutes until whites set but yolks are runny.
Lift eggs with a slotted spoon onto paper towels to drain briefly.
Plate hash, top with the poached eggs and reserved bacon. Crack pepper over and serve.

name: Lemon Cottage Cheese Pancakes
instructions: Whisk egg yolks, cottage cheese, milk, lemon zest and juice, sugar, and salt until smooth-ish (chunks are fine).
Stir in flour just until combined — don't overwork.
Beat egg whites to soft peaks; fold gently into the batter for extra-light pancakes.
Melt butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low. Drop 1/4-cup pancakes; cook 2 minutes until bubbles dot the surface, flip, cook 1 minute more.
Stack hot pancakes with honey and an extra squeeze of lemon.

name: Spinach & Feta Mini Quiches
instructions: Pulse flour, butter, and a pinch of salt in a food processor (or rub by hand) until pea-sized crumbs. Drizzle 3-4 tbsp ice water in until the dough just clumps. Chill 20 minutes.
Heat oven to 375°F. Roll dough thin, cut into rounds, press into a 12-cup muffin tin.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil 3 minutes; stir in spinach and Italian seasoning. Cool slightly.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and pepper. Stir in the spinach mixture and crumbled feta.
Divide custard between crusts. Bake 22-26 minutes until tops are golden and just set.
Cool 5 minutes before unmolding. Keep up to 4 days in the fridge.

name: Crepes with Berry Cream Cheese Filling
instructions: Blend flour, eggs, milk, melted butter, a pinch of salt, and 1 tbsp sugar into a thin batter. Rest 15 minutes.
Warm berries with the remaining sugar and lemon juice in a small pot, 8 minutes, until thickened. Cool slightly.
Whip cream cheese with lemon zest and a drizzle of honey until smooth.
Heat a nonstick pan over medium with a little butter. Pour ~1/3 cup batter, swirl to coat, cook 60 seconds; flip and cook 20 seconds more. Stack between parchment as you go.
Spread each crepe with cream cheese filling, spoon berries down the center, roll up.
Plate 2 per serving; drizzle with extra berry sauce.

name: Tomato Mozzarella Bagel Sandwich
instructions: Split and lightly toast the bagel.
Drizzle olive oil onto the bottom half; sprinkle Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Layer mozzarella, tomato slices, and lettuce.
Close with the top, slice in half, and serve.

name: Turkey & Cheddar Pinwheel Wraps
instructions: Whisk cream cheese with mustard until smooth.
Spread the mixture across each tortilla edge-to-edge.
Layer with turkey, cheddar, lettuce, and tomato.
Roll up tightly. Trim ends, then slice into 1-inch pinwheels.
Serve right away or wrap and refrigerate up to a day.

name: Greek Beef Pita with Tzatziki
instructions: Stir yogurt, grated cucumber, 1 clove garlic (minced), half the lemon juice, salt, and pepper into tzatziki. Chill while you cook.
Mix beef with diced onion, the other clove of garlic, Italian seasoning, cumin, the rest of the lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Form into 8 small patties (kefta-style).
Sear patties in olive oil over medium-high, 3 minutes per side.
Warm the pitas in a dry pan, 20 seconds per side.
Stuff each pita with patties, tomato, lettuce, and a generous spoon of tzatziki.

name: Salmon Avocado Power Bowl
instructions: Pat salmon dry, season with salt. Sear skin-side down in olive oil over medium-high 4 minutes; flip and cook 2 minutes more. Let rest, then flake into large chunks.
Whisk soy sauce, sesame oil, and honey for a quick dressing.
Build bowls: rice base, salmon, avocado, cucumber, carrots, green onion.
Drizzle the dressing over and serve with lime wedges to squeeze.

name: Pasta Carbonara

ingredients.measure: 3/4 cup grated, plus more to serve

instructions: Boil pasta in well-salted water until just al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
While pasta cooks, render bacon in a wide cold skillet over medium until crisp. Lift bacon out, leave a film of fat. Toss in garlic and bloom 30 seconds, then discard.
In a bowl, whisk eggs, yolk, parmesan, and a ton of black pepper into a thick paste.
Drop drained pasta into the warm skillet with butter; remove from heat (this is critical — no live heat).
Pour egg mixture over while tossing constantly. Splash in pasta water a tablespoon at a time until the sauce turns silky and clings.
Fold bacon back in. Plate with more parmesan and pepper on top.

name: Banh Mi-Inspired Pork Sandwich
instructions: Whisk vinegar and sugar in a bowl; toss carrot and cucumber in to quick-pickle while you cook.
Marinate pork in soy sauce, honey, garlic, and ginger for 10 minutes.
Sear pork in a hot skillet 2 minutes per side until caramelized and just cooked through.
Stir mayo with hot sauce until pink.
Toast bread cut-side down briefly. Spread with spicy mayo, layer with pork, pickled vegetables, jalapeño, and cilantro.
Close, slice, and serve with lime wedges.

name: Skillet Lemon Butter Salmon with Rice
instructions: Pat salmon dry, season with salt, pepper, and Italian seasoning.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear salmon skin-side down 4 minutes until crispy; flip and cook 2 minutes more. Lift out.
Lower heat. Melt butter, add garlic, cook 30 seconds. Stir in lemon juice.
Return salmon briefly to spoon sauce over.
Plate over rice with steamed broccoli; serve with lemon wedges.

name: Quick Garlic Butter Shrimp & Rice
instructions: Pat shrimp dry, toss with paprika, salt, and pepper.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp in a single layer; cook 90 seconds per side until pink and just opaque.
Off heat, stir in lemon juice and cilantro.
Serve over rice with hot sauce on the side.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Beef & Rice
instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. Stand peppers cut-side up in a baking dish; pour 1/4 inch of water around them.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil 3 minutes. Add beef and brown, breaking it up. Drain fat.
Stir in cooked rice, half the tomato sauce, Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Spoon filling into the peppers, mounding the tops. Pour remaining tomato sauce over and around.
Cover with foil; bake 35 minutes. Uncover, top with cheese, bake 10 more minutes until peppers are tender and cheese is bubbly.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Stovetop Korean Bulgogi Beef Bowl

ingredients.measure: 1 lb flank or sirloin, sliced paper-thin

instructions: Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, ginger, and garlic. Toss with sliced beef; marinate 15 minutes (or up to overnight).
Heat vegetable oil in a wide skillet over high until shimmering. Sear beef in a single layer in two batches, 90 seconds per side, until edges are caramelized.
Return all beef to the pan with onion; toss 1 minute to coat in the glaze.
Build bowls: rice base, beef with sauce, raw carrots, cucumber, and green onions.
Pass hot sauce at the table.

name: Mushroom & Parmesan Risotto

ingredients.measure: 3/4 cup grated, plus more to serve

instructions: Sauté mushrooms in 2 tbsp butter and 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high until deeply browned, 8 minutes; season, set aside.
In the same pan, heat 1 tbsp olive oil; sweat onion 4 minutes until soft. Stir in garlic, cook 30 seconds.
Add rice; toast 2 minutes, stirring, until edges are translucent.
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring gently, waiting until each addition is absorbed before adding the next. Continue 20-25 minutes until rice is creamy and al dente.
Off heat, stir in mushrooms, the remaining 2 tbsp butter, parmesan, Italian seasoning, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Rest 2 minutes, then ladle into shallow bowls with more parmesan on top.

name: Crispy Pork Schnitzel with Lemon
instructions: Boil potatoes for the side in salted water 15 minutes; drain, toss with 1 tbsp butter, salt, and pepper. Keep warm.
Set up dredging stations: seasoned flour (with paprika, salt, pepper), beaten eggs, breadcrumbs. Pat pork dry, season both sides.
Coat each cutlet: flour, egg, crumbs — press to adhere.
Heat oil and remaining butter in a wide skillet over medium-high until shimmering (not smoking).
Shallow-fry cutlets 2-3 minutes per side until deep golden and 145°F inside. Drain on paper towels.
Plate with buttered potatoes and big lemon wedges to squeeze over.
